notes.title: Expo Updates 1
notes.notes:

[b]Change of plans. After taking my game to a local game expo and having random people playing it who were there to compete in other games, I realized what a perfect fit it is for tournaments. Changes now will be geared towards that, which of course also enhances playing it at home. First big change is being able to pass all 4 controllers over to 4 new people and being able to enter names and colors simultaniously with the controllers. More to come as I book more spaces to set up, so stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign launched today! (+ vehicles update)
notes.notes:
Driveable Vehicles have been added to the game! Anywhere you see a vehicle can now be entered and driven! Check the CPGN youtube channel if you're interested or just hop into the game!

Here's the big news.. I think everyone FINALLY understands this game was published to Steam's EA to WATCH IT DEVELOP! I'm always kind of shocked people seem to say REALLY stupid things like "this game feels like it's not finished" ..YEAH NO SH!T lol.. but you're welcome for allowing you to play it while it's being developed. Are you a gamer or, what is this, lol..

Anyway, I've explain a million times I've only ever been able to work on this game for a few hours a week and or whenever I have time that allows it. BUT..

If you really can't wait and want me to devote 100% of my time on it and work on this game to complete it FULL-TIME, you can join my KickStarter campaign and I will quit my job for 1 year and FINISH it.

Details, goals, and rewards [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/danhouser82/couch-party-game-night-10]here[/url]! If you've already bought the game, awesome! Just tell your friends and family about this campaign and I'LL GET IT DONE!

notes.title: Still Going
notes.notes:
Small update for now just to let everyone know that the game hasn't been abandoned and never will be. Like I said before, this was and is a life-long passion project that continues to grow, even in cases where we get a little too busy with our day jobs and disappear for awhile! We could work on it full-time if we had the funding but so far sales have only slowed and investors only want to rip us off still. This project will reach standing ovation with or without them. Gamers who fell in love with the golden era of gaming will always have CPGN to look forward to!
